Agent Name: Bioinformatics_Expert  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Bioinformatics_Expert failed to identify the most relevant link for the dog genome files as of May 2020. The correct link is ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/, which was not mentioned in the provided search results. Instead, the Bioinformatics_Expert focused on other genome assemblies and research articles that were not directly linked to the requested files. The oversight occurred during the web search and interpretation of results, resulting in the omission of the most relevant link.
